wiki.title: Owen Pappoe
wiki.intro: Owen Pappoe (born September 29, 2000) is an American professional football linebacker for the Detroit Lions of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Auburn Tigers and was selected by the Arizona Cardinals in the fifth round of the 2023 NFL draft.

sections.title: Early life
sections.text: Pappoe attended Grayson High School in Loganville, Georgia. As a senior, he had 121 tackles. He played in the 2019 Under Armour All-America Game. A five-star recruit, Pappoe committed to Auburn University to play college football. He is of Liberian descent.

sections.title: College career
sections.text: Pappoe entered his true freshman season at Auburn in 2019 as a starter. He started all 13 games, recording 49 tackles and two sacks. He returned to Auburn as a starter his sophomore year in 2020 and recorded 93 tackles and 4 sacks. Due to injuries, Pappoe only appeared in 5 games for Auburn in 2021.

sections.title: Professional career
sections.text:
ARIZONA CARDINALS
Pappoe was selected by the Arizona Cardinals in the fifth round, 168 overall, of the 2023 NFL draft.
On August 30, 2026, Pappoe was waived by the Cardinals as a part of roster cuts before the start of the regular season.

TENNESSEE TITANS
On August 31, 2026, Pappoe was claimed off of waivers by the Tennessee Titans. He was waived by the Titans on September 26 and re-signed to the practice squad three days later. On October 6, he was released.

DETROIT LIONS
On November 4, 2026, Pappoe was signed to the Detroit Lions' practice squad.
